name: TrueSignal Hub admin login failures
description: Five or more failed Hub dashboard logins (POST /login, HTTP 401 or 429) from one source in 10 minutes. The Hub locks out per IP and account-wide, but repeated failures mean someone is trying the admin password of the deception platform.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: An admin with a wrong saved password or a script with a stale `TS_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD`.
MFA logins (one 401 before the code is entered).
note:
## Triage
1. `source.ip` is the client as the Hub saw it. Behind a proxy it is only correct if `TS_TRUSTED_PROXIES` is set; otherwise it may be the proxy.
2. Check for a successful `POST /login` from the same source afterwards.
3. With MFA, each normal login first returns 401 `mfa_required`; a few failures per admin login are expected.
